description: a lean slavic hunter for hire in his thirties, short brown hair, stubble and a scar across one eyebrow, a fur-trimmed leather hood down on his shoulders, a leather jerkin, a quiver on his back, brown trousers and boots, a hunting bow in his hand, seen from the side, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
